I am growing beans on this small plot, and I know legumes do not need chemical fertilizer like maize does. I will plant the same bean seeds I saved from last season, since buying improved seed is too costly for a crop like beans. This plot is small enough that my family can manage all the work ourselves without hiring ganyu labor, and we depend on the rains because we have no irrigation.
